pose_text_ja: 腰を足より高い位置に置いて座り、上体を少し後ろへ傾ける。本人の右脚を左脚の膝の上で組み、上の右すねを画面左へ斜めに伸ばし、左すねを下へ向ける。両上腕を体から少し開き、両肘を約90度曲げる。画面左の右手を胸の下あたりへ上げ、細い軸を持つように親指と指を小さな空間の周りへ緩く曲げる。左手は低めで開き、指の力を抜く。頭を少し後ろへ傾け、顔を画面左へ向け、顎を少し上げて左上を見る。浮遊や飛行の表現にはしない。
pose_template: Reclined seated posture with the hips elevated above the feet, torso leaning back slightly. Cross the anatomical right leg over the left at the knee; the upper right shin runs diagonally toward screen-left, while the left lower leg drops down. Both upper arms spread a little from the torso and both elbows bend about 90 degrees. Right hand at screen-left is raised near the lower chest, with thumb and fingers gently curved around a small empty gap as if holding a stem. Left hand is lower and open, fingers relaxed. Tilt the head back a little, turn the face toward screen-left, chin slightly raised, gaze upward toward screen-left. No floating or flying effect.
original_gemini_prompt: floating seated posture, legs crossed at the knee (one leg over the other), both arms slightly spread and bent forward at the elbows

prompt_validation.note: 両腕の開き、右手の高さ、左手首の向きは追加調整の余地あり。

pose_text_ja: 本人のまっすぐな右脚（画面左）に主に体重をかけて立ち、左膝を軽く曲げ、左足を右足首の後ろに添える。腰から上体を約30度前へ倒し、肩の力を抜く。両上腕を前下方へ向け、肘を胸より明らかに低く、腰の前へ置く。両前腕を腰の高さでほぼ水平に前へ伸ばし、体の中心線付近で両手を緩く合わせる。手は胸より十分低く、顔から離す。頭も上体とともに前へ傾け、顎を少し引き、顔を前下方、目を眉の下から前へ向ける。静止してくつろいだ前傾姿勢。
pose_template: Standing with the weight mostly on the straight anatomical right leg (screen-left), the left knee softly bent and the left foot tucked behind the right ankle. Hinge the torso forward at the hips about 30 degrees, shoulders relaxed. Both upper arms angle forward and down; elbows remain clearly below the chest and in front of the waist. Both forearms extend almost horizontally forward at waist height, with the hands loosely joined near the centerline. The hands stay well below the chest, away from the face. Head follows the forward inclination, chin slightly lowered, face directed forward and slightly down, eyes looking ahead beneath the brow. This is a stationary relaxed leaning pose.
original_gemini_prompt: sneaking or creeping pose, torso hunched forward, both elbows bent tight against the chest with hands raised in front, knees slightly bent

prompt_validation.note: 候補は身体配置だけのB。各1枚の試行なので、counterの有無による成功率や因果は判断できない。
